result.instructions: Tools for Linnworks, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which open orders came in today and which are still waiting to be despatched?"; "What is the stock level of SKU ABC-123 in each warehouse?"; "Find the order with eBay reference 12-34567-89012 and show its tracking number.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Linnworks data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run linnworks_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run linnworks_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run linnworks_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. linnworks_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: linnworks_list_stock_locations
tools.title: List stock locations
tools.description: List the stock locations (warehouses, fulfilment centres) of the Linnworks account: id, name, address, whether it is a fulfilment centre. Use the ids as location_id in other tools. GET /api/Inventory/GetStockLocations.

tools.name: linnworks_search_inventory
tools.title: Search inventory
tools.description: Search the product catalogue by SKU, title or barcode and return the items with their stock levels per location (and optionally pricing, suppliers, images, extended properties). An empty keyword lists items. POST /api/Stock/GetStockItemsFull.

keyword.description: Text to search for (SKU, title or barcode). Empty = list items.

search_in.description: Fields to search (default: SKU, Title and Barcode).

include.description: Extra data to load per item (default: StockLevels).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: linnworks_get_inventory_item
tools.title: Get inventory item
tools.description: One product by its stock item id: SKU (ItemNumber), title, barcode, quantities (in stock, in orders, due, available), prices, tax rate, category, dimensions and weight. GET /api/Inventory/GetInventoryItemById.

stock_item_id.description: The stock item id (StockItemId) from linnworks_search_inventory.

tools.name: linnworks_get_stock_levels
tools.title: Get stock levels
tools.description: The stock level of one product at every location: in stock, in open orders, due on purchase orders, available, minimum level, unit cost and when it last changed. GET /api/Stock/GetStockLevel.

stock_item_id.description: The stock item id (StockItemId) from linnworks_search_inventory.

tools.name: linnworks_get_stock_history
tools.title: Get stock change history
tools.description: The stock-level change history of one product (date, new level, change quantity, value, note), newest data first as Linnworks returns it; optionally for a single location, otherwise combined. GET /api/Stock/GetItemChangesHistory.

location_id.description: Limit to one stock location (default: all locations combined).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: linnworks_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List the product categories (id and name). GET /api/Inventory/GetCategories.

tools.name: linnworks_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: List the suppliers: id, name, contact, address, email, web page and currency. GET /api/Inventory/GetSuppliers.

tools.name: linnworks_list_open_orders
tools.title: List open orders
tools.description: Page through the open (not yet processed) orders of a fulfilment location, with general info (status, reference, source, received date), shipping, customer, totals and items. Narrow with text filters (reference, customer, SKU ...) and a received-date range. POST /api/Orders/GetOpenOrders.

location_id.description: Fulfilment location id from linnworks_list_stock_locations (default: the account's default location).

received_from.description: Only orders received on or after this date.

received_to.description: Only orders received on or before this date.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: linnworks_get_open_orders_details
tools.title: Get open order details
tools.description: Full details of open orders by their ids (up to 50): general info, shipping, customer, totals, items, folders, notes, identifiers, extended properties and bin racks. Pass include to load only some of the optional parts. Only works for open orders. POST /api/OpenOrders/GetOpenOrdersDetails.

order_ids.description: Order ids (OrderId, a GUID) from linnworks_list_open_orders.

include.description: Limit the optional parts loaded (default: all of them).

tools.name: linnworks_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: One order, open or processed, by its order id (a GUID): general info, shipping, customer, totals, items, notes. GET /api/Orders/GetOrderById.

tools.name: linnworks_find_order_by_number
tools.title: Find order by order number
tools.description: Find one order, open or processed, by its Linnworks order number (the integer shown in the order book). Returns an empty order when none matches. GET /api/Orders/GetOrderDetailsByNumOrderId.

tools.name: linnworks_find_orders_by_reference
tools.title: Find orders by channel reference
tools.description: Find orders by their channel reference number (for example an Amazon or eBay order number) or secondary reference. Returns at most 50 orders. GET /api/Orders/GetOrderDetailsByReferenceId.

reference.description: The reference number or secondary reference to look for.

tools.name: linnworks_search_processed_orders
tools.title: Search processed orders
tools.description: Search processed (despatched) orders. Search by order number, tracking number, channel reference, customer name, email, postcode, address, SKU, source or sub-source, optionally within a date range (at most 3 months; a non-exact search covers only the last 3 months). POST /api/ProcessedOrders/SearchProcessedOrdersPaged.

search_field.description: What to search by: nOrderId (order number), o.PostalTrackingNumber, ReferenceNum, CustomerName, o.cEmailAddress, o.cPostCode, ShippingAddress, SKU (SKU or barcode), Source, SubSource.

exact_match.description: Exact match (default false: partial match over the last 3 months).

date_type.description: Which date the range applies to (default ALLDATES = no range).

date_from.description: Start of the range (needs date_type other than ALLDATES).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: linnworks_get_order_notes
tools.title: Get order notes
tools.description: The notes on an order (text, internal or external, who wrote them and when). GET /api/Orders/GetOrderNotes.

tools.name: linnworks_list_postal_services
tools.title: List postal services
tools.description: List the postal (shipping) services with their courier vendor, tracking and weight requirements and linked channels. GET /api/PostalServices/GetPostalServices.

tools.name: linnworks_set_stock_level
tools.title: Set stock level
tools.description: WRITE: set the stock level of one product (by SKU) at one location to an absolute quantity. This overwrites the current level and flows to the sales channels the item is listed on. Check the current level with linnworks_get_stock_levels first. POST /api/Stock/SetStockLevel.

location_id.description: The stock location id from linnworks_list_stock_locations.

level.description: The new stock level (units, 0 or more).

tools.name: linnworks_add_order_note
tools.title: Add order note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to an order (open or processed). Internal notes are visible only inside Linnworks; external notes may be passed to the sales channel. Adds a new note each call (not idempotent). POST /api/Orders/AddOrdersNote.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Linnworks
prompts.description: What you can do with Linnworks here, with example requests to try.
